Whole-first: the S0 record’s own movement path (#0 → #5→0) staged in order; every scene binds the S0 record (essay path + sha256 above) by its exact movement heading (verified present in the bound bytes at freeze time) plus one material record from the frozen inventory. Scene ids derive from the S record’s movement headings. Presentation mappings (tint, ground, term row, layout) are declared craft. Not corpus-complete: full per-product depth (all inventoried records as scenes) is the following fan-out.

Moves — #0 s0-m0-ground: quiet emergence; commitments→histories→promises→inheritances→interpretations walks what a Life carries (3D here — z is continuity's layers: the living surface nearest, the carried inheritances deepest). #1 s0-m1-sayable-ground: gather (attraction keeps the field); Why→What→How→Whom/When→Where/Why-for→Why-so/Not walks the sayable dimensions. #2 s0-m2-disclosure-return: turn (disclosure unveils — vortex); Arche→Apokalypsis→Dynamis→Sophia→Parousia→Epi-Logos walks the Logos pair. #3 s0-m3-authorship: hold (authorship without enclosure — guard; P0→P5 walk the authored offices). #4 s0-m4-carried-world: gather — Bimba→Pratibimba walks the order of dependence, causal effectiveness brightening. #5->0 s0-m5-revisable-continuity: settle — correction→governing source→revised commission→changed categories walks the return; slow speed LFO.

3D: the member's depth is continuity layers — z is Central's own depth relation: the living surface nearest, the carried ground deepest (laminated; depthPerspective on). Pointers: guard=sources hold their standing, gather=continuity gathers the field (Central holds by attraction), vortex=correction turns the ground, rupture=recovery from loss, settle=continuity at rest. Automation: one LFO per member — the carried ground breathes. Sequences walk each record's own heading words.
